integrity: The proof uses the focal paper's stated definition, Q-Folner orthogonality lemma, and tail estimate, together with standard compact-abelian harmonic analysis. No computational experiment is used as evidence for an infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: Qualitative limit-set theorem only; no rate, positive relative density, nonabelian target statement, or multivariate equidistribution criterion is proved. Originality risk remains from unindexed compact-group formulations or later revisions of the focal preprint.
title: Joint value limits on multiplicatively pseudorandom sets
